gaps.note: Edit to Lori asking about his background.
Edit to Daniel asking about valuation.
Edit to Mark advising against the deal.

stage_a.note: Smiling, energetic, arms wide open while presenting.
Passionate tone when describing the traditional recipes from Guatemala.
Very friendly and inviting demeanor toward the panel.

venture.description: Healthy, low-sugar, sparkling versions of traditional Latin American aguas frescas.
venture.note: The founder is asking for 130k for 8 percent equity.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: Presents the company, the product line of sparkling aguas frescas, and the ask.

turns.speaker: S5
turns.summary: Cheers enthusiastically in Spanish.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.summary: Laughs along with the founder.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: Invites the sharks to taste the beverages and explains the flavors.

turns.speaker: S3
turns.summary: Expresses strong positive reaction to the taste of the drink.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.summary: Agrees the drink is delicious in Spanish.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.summary: Comments that the drink feels light.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: Points out the fresh fruit aroma of the drink.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.summary: Asks about the calorie content per can.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: States there are sixty calories per can.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.summary: Asks if sugar content varies by flavor.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: Clarifies there are five to ten grams of added sugar.

turns.speaker: S4
turns.summary: Tastes the beverage.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.summary: Describes the drink as fruity with light carbonation.

turns.speaker: S3
turns.summary: Asks the founder to share his background.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: Explains he is from Guatemala and his son had the idea.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.summary: Asks if his son is also working on the business.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: Clarifies his son is nineteen and this is his second food company.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: Continues explaining how his son suggested bottling the drinks.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.summary: Asks about the game plan, co-packer, and distribution.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: Shares they got accepted into Kroger and four major retailers.

turns.speaker: S3
turns.summary: Expresses amazement and asks how many stores.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: Details the number of stores in Colorado and California.

turns.speaker: S4
turns.summary: Asks if they have started shipping yet.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: Confirms they started shipping last year and shares sales figures.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.summary: Expresses positive surprise at the sales numbers.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: Reiterates the first-year sales figure.

turns.speaker: S4
turns.summary: Asks for projected sales for the year 2022.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: States current sales and projects finishing the year higher.

turns.speaker: S5
turns.summary: Questions the high valuation based on current sales figures.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: Justifies valuation with projected end-of-year and next-year sales.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.summary: Asks about the cost to make and wholesale price.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: States the manufacturing cost and wholesale price per can.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.summary: Asks for the retail price for the end consumer.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: Explains the retail price varies but averages around four fifty.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.summary: Repeats the retail price for confirmation.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: Confirms the price but mentions wanting it lower.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.summary: Asks for the average cost of a competitor's product.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: States competitors cost around three ninety-nine.

turns.speaker: S3
turns.summary: Asks about the price of a standard can of sparkling water.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: Admits sparkling water is cheaper but lacks the flavor.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.summary: Exits because he feels he would have to teach too much.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.summary: Praises the pitch but exits due to the difficult beverage market.

turns.speaker: S4
turns.summary: Exits because he hates the challenging beverage business model.

turns.speaker: S3
turns.summary: Exits due to the expensive and competitive nature of the space.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.summary: Reminds the founder that one shark is still left.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: Pitches his vision to expand across the Americas to Daniel.

turns.speaker: S5
turns.summary: Praises the founder but asks if he knows how hard it will be.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: Shares his son's battle with cancer to prove his resilience.

turns.speaker: S5
turns.summary: Offers to invest if the founder convinces another shark first.

turns.speaker: S4
turns.summary: States there are no other sharks left to convince.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: Agrees that this is exactly the situation he wanted.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.summary: Re-enters and offers one hundred thirty thousand for thirty percent.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: Expresses surprise at the offer.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.summary: Invites Daniel to split the thirty percent offer with him.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: Counters Kevin's offer with twenty percent equity.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.summary: Rejects the twenty percent counter and stands firm.

turns.speaker: S5
turns.summary: Offers one hundred thirty thousand for twenty-five percent.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: Accepts twenty-five percent but asks for production financing help.

turns.speaker: S3
turns.summary: Asks for clarification on whether the founder accepted the offer.

turns.speaker: S5
turns.summary: Clarifies he will do twenty-five percent and explore financing.

turns.speaker: S4
turns.summary: Advises the founder against taking the deal due to valuation.

turns.speaker: S5
turns.summary: Jokes that Mark's free advice is worth what was paid for it.

turns.speaker: S5
turns.summary: Clarifies he cannot guarantee financing and stands at twenty-five percent.

turns.speaker: F1
turns.summary: Accepts Daniel's final offer.

turns.speaker: S5
turns.summary: Congratulates the founder on making the deal.

decisions.note: Needs too much teaching, not for him.
Getting market share in beverage is impossible, logistics unsolved.
Hates beverage business, limited shelf space, high slotting fees.
Accepts 25% but asks for production financing.

record.notes: Very energetic pitch. The guest shark Daniel Lubetzky joins the panel.
